text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d love to help with this Data Entry Clerk role.

With 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, data cleaning, and data visualization, I bring strong attention to detail and a careful approach to accurate data work. I’m comfortable entering data, maintaining records, processing documents, and keeping systems organized and reliable.

On a recent project, I built a Power BI sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture using a star-schema model with SQL Server and Excel. That work consolidated 14 separate Excel sales reports into one and reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours.

I’d be glad to support your team with accurate, efficient, and organized data entry work.
